news.title: A critically underrated gem.
news.summary:
Morimens is a gem. I’d go as far to say it’s one of the best gacha games out there for gacha gamers who want something more than just run-of-the-mill waifu collectors.

This game is hard as nails. It has countless grotesque, terrifying, Lovecraftian scenes. The number of people who beat the story’s hard mode is in the double digits. It will grind you up to dust and spit you out.

Yet, I keep coming back to it like a drug.

It’s a card battler that plays a lot like Slay the Spire. It has a steampunk aesthetic. So why is it so addictive?

It’s simple- it’s a roguelite that you have endless variety with, with so many bosses and lovely gimmicks. When you have a boss standing over you with over a thousand health and an attack that can one-shot you, you only have one option- see what you can do to get out of this.

If you want a hidden gem that’s so satisfying to play, Morimens won’t disappoint.

news.title: Genuinely great gacha but…
news.summary:
The short: Amazing gacha game. The iOS app could use some stability improvements.

The very long:

I wish I could give this 5 stars. It’s a great game with amazing art direction, writing, and isn’t afraid to explore mature themes, given the Lovecraftian nature of the world.

And everything you need to deep dive into the world is in the game itself. A whole library of terms, stories, and radio dramas can be easily viewed within the game.

The gacha itself is pretty generous. To fully unlock a character’s potential might take a lot of duplicate draws but to get the characters themselves, you get plenty of resources to do so.

I only wish the game didn’t crash on iOS like it had a DUI quota. On the plus side, the game is very proactive about saving where you are so a crash loses you no progress. But when I’m going back to the iPhone home screen literally once every chapter or 3 times in a long boss fight, it becomes a very frustrating experience.

Using the fix button on the login screen also did not help the problem. I truly love this game, but I love it a lot more on PC.

作为一个从开服肝到现在的玩家，我觉得这游戏评分不该这么低，至少我在新手时期也就是刚开服的时候深刻体会到校猫（游戏制作人）对玩家和对这款游戏的良苦用心，他是真的愿意让林冲玩家和氪佬都体会到游戏中独有的属于他们的一份乐趣，也愿意在剧情或者角色平衡性这块和玩家一起探讨好坏。基本上每个小版本结束就会发一份问卷，我相信这次活动“花与春天的诗”非常成功离不开每一份问卷的功劳。
至于有些氪金角色强度平衡的麻烦事，官方的补偿说实话很大方，对于我们零氪和微氪玩家来说确实是堪比记忆消除的福利，但对于一些玩家在充值这方面的伤害也确实弥补不回来。希望官方能挺过这几波舆论风波，在以后不会犯下这种失误了。
现在游戏活动模式已经将肝度调整为基本都可接受的程度，活动副本难度面向所有等级的玩家，游戏剧情模式除了后面2章有点难，前面的就算用开局的四小只也能轻松打过，不用担心卡关问题，以前的卡等级在如今也荡然无存（新密契除外）。从开服就算零氪玩到现在也已经能体验99%的游戏内容了，现在入坑就也不知道福利咋样，但多肝肝，等几个月活动就能都复刻一遍。
因为这次活动从游戏性到艺术风格我都很满意，尤其是pv做的相当好。希望忘却前夜能接着保持这份初心，我认为这才是我选择这款游戏的原因。

I *REALLY* LOVE THIS GAME, but changes were announced that I just could not get behind and I'll change my review the moment the devs change their minds about it.

D-Zone, the "endgame" mode of the game, was amazing and really fun. It didnt allow shortcuts, gave really good rewards, had varying difficulties for newer accounts to get left behind and, due to the fact that was all there was to it, the experiences between players were largely similar, allowing people that struggled to see people just as strong as them or even weaker extract wildly different results, shining a beautiful light in the game's very good game design and how almost every character could be used and do amazing.

It was announced that, due to whales and people that have spent thousands of hours of the game (way less than the 1% of the community) could, due to all they amassed not only in terms of acquisition but also knowledge and experience, finish some of the hardest fights in one turn (WOW, HIGH INVESTMENT BEING REWARDED?!), so now the devs think that the challenge is not good enough and now they will make nightmare modes and, to not leave the PLEBS behind, allow people to "use shortcuts" such as "second lives" mid combat in case they wipe (be restored to full immediately).

Whale exclusive content (if you dont "cheat"), shortcuts to trivialize easier stuff, fragment the community by making their experiences less alike due to the fact that some may not choose to use the revive and some play in wildly different difficulties... Is that it?

Hopefully we see better judgement on their part before any of this makes into the game... Please don't smear this feces on such a great game.
